projects.name: EXAMPLE: Spread Watch Agent
projects.summary: EXAMPLE ENTRY. An agent that checks two price sources and writes down why it did or did not act, using recorded data.
projects.limitation: EXAMPLE ENTRY. Only tested on one recorded hour; a stale price once slipped through before the age check.

projects.name: EXAMPLE: Order Book Component
projects.summary: EXAMPLE ENTRY. A small matching component with a test for every rejected order, deployed to devnet.
projects.limitation: EXAMPLE ENTRY. Two tests fail on partial fills; they are listed in the README as known failures.

projects.name: EXAMPLE: Clean Checkout Checker
projects.summary: EXAMPLE ENTRY. A command-line tool that runs a fresh clone of a project and reports which README steps failed.
projects.limitation: EXAMPLE ENTRY. Reads files only and does not run Python projects. No devnet transaction: a tool does not need one.
